name: The Renegade
tagline: The Original. The Icon. The Renegade.
subtitle: The one that started it all. Distressed, one-of-a-kind, and built with outlaw attitude.
story:
Every story has a beginning, and this is where Renegade Hats began.

The Original Renegade was the first hat I reshaped, distressed and transformed into something completely my own. I wanted a hat with character — something rugged, rebellious and a little bit unpredictable. What started as one idea became the look and spirit behind Renegade Hats.

Built by hand and finished with layers of vintage-inspired details, feathers and an unmistakable outlaw edge, this hat isn’t just the first Renegade — it’s the reason the Renegade exists at all.

One of a kind. Handcrafted. No rules.
hatband: Double-layered black-and-white patterned hatband with distressed detailing, giving the original Renegade its unmistakable outlaw character.
description: The Original Renegade — the hat that started it all. Hand-distressed and reshaped by hand, with a bold layered hatband, feathers, vintage playing-card detail and rugged outlaw character. A true one-of-a-kind Renegade, built for those who make their own rules.

name: Roll the Bones
tagline: For the ones who walk in loud.
subtitle: Crimson Felt Card-Sharp Hat
story: Renegade Red is made for anyone who walks into a room loud. The crimson felt was distressed by hand to soften the colour and give it depth, and the brim edge was hand-patterned in black and white. A black band holds a skull playing card tucked in for luck — a little card-sharp swagger in every angle.
hatband: Black band with skull playing card & porcupine quill
description: Crimson red felt with a hand-patterned black and white brim edge, a black band and a skull playing card tucked in for luck. Impossible to ignore.

name: The Shaman
subtitle: Hand-Burned Pyrography Hat
story: The Shaman is part hat, part talisman. Every mark on the cream felt was burned in by hand — a moth across the crown and patterns running around the brim. It's finished with white feathers and carries the most hours of handwork in the collection.
description: Cream felt covered entirely in hand-burned pyrography — a moth on the crown, tribal patterns across the brim — finished with pheasant and turkey feathers.

name: Whiskey Business
subtitle: Distressed Brown Western Hat
story:
THE STORY BEHIND THE OUTLAW

Whiskey Business was made for those who don’t follow the rules.

Hand-distressed and reshaped with a rugged western attitude, this hat was built to look like it has a few stories of its own. The worn finish, bold crown and layered hatband give it that weathered, road-worn character that feels right at home anywhere the rules get left behind.

Finished with feathers, vintage-inspired details, metal accents and a touch of renegade attitude, Whiskey Business is anything but ordinary.

No apologies. No rules. Just attitude.
hatband: Layered black leather and patterned band with a rich brown leather accent, finished with a bull-skull centerpiece, brass-toned details, feathers and a vintage bullet casing
description: A rugged, hand-distressed western hat with layered band, feathers and unmistakable outlaw character.
details: Layered black leather and patterned band

name: The Wanderer
subtitle: Caramel Suede Travelling Hat
story:
Some hats are made to stay home. The Wanderer was made to roam.

Hand-distressed and reshaped with a rugged, weathered character, this hat has the look of something that has already seen a few miles and is ready for a few more. The sculpted crown, worn finish and hand-stitched details give it a well-traveled spirit.

Layered textures, natural jute rope, feathers and carefully chosen metal accents come together to create a hat that feels completely at home on the open road.

For the restless souls, the free spirits and anyone who’d rather take the long way home.

One of a kind. Handcrafted. Made for the road less travelled.
hatband: Layered black band featuring patterned fabric, natural jute cord, a silver-tone chain and handcrafted rope detailing, finished with a feather accent and metal embellishments
description: A hand-distressed western original with a sculpted crown, layered band, feathers and rugged outlaw character.
details: Some hats are made to stay home. The Wanderer was made to roam.

One of a kind. Handcrafted. Made for the road less travelled.

name: The Rustler
subtitle: A rich pink-copper finish and bold detailing
story:
The Rustler was made for the ones who were never meant to blend in.

With its weathered copper tones, sculpted crown and rugged finish, this hat has the feel of something pulled straight from an old western road — worn by time, dust and a few questionable decisions.

The layered hatband and carefully chosen vintage-inspired embellishments give The Rustler its own unmistakable character. Every detail was added by hand to create a hat that feels broken-in, rebellious and completely unique.

It doesn’t need to be perfect. It just needs to have a story.

The Rustler — Born to Run Wild.
hatband: Layered black and silver snakeskin patterned bands with a textured woven accent, finished with a silver-tone chain and antique-style metal centerpiece.
description: A richly distressed western hat in warm copper tones, featuring a sculpted crown, layered band and rugged handcrafted details.

name: The Nomad
subtitle: Western hat with rich earthy tones & free-spirited details.
story:
The Nomad was made for the free spirits who never stay in one place for too long.

With its rich weathered copper and rust tones, this hat has a warm, well-traveled character that feels like it belongs around a campfire, on an open highway, or wherever the road happens to lead.

The layered band combines braided textures, leather, metal accents and a striking peacock feather, creating a look that’s equal parts rugged and free-spirited. Every detail was chosen and finished by hand to give The Nomad its own personality.

No destination. No rules. Just follow the road.

The Nomad — Made for the restless soul.
colour: Rich weathered copper brown with warm rust and earthy burnt-umber tones.
hatband: Layered black gator, braided natural cord and silver-tone chain, accented with brass-toned beads and a striking peacock feather for a rugged, free-spirited finish.
description: A richly distressed western hat in warm copper and rust tones, finished with handcrafted stitching, braided detailing, feathers and rugged metal accents.

name: The Maverick
tagline: Born to ride outside the lines.
subtitle: Earthy tones, turquoise beadwork, feathers and free-spirited character.
story:
The Maverick was made for the ones who refuse to ride with the crowd.

Its weathered olive finish gives it a rugged, well-traveled character, while the layered leather band, turquoise beadwork, feathers and brass-toned details bring a touch of the unexpected.

Every element was chosen and finished by hand to create a hat with its own personality — earthy, rebellious and completely one of a kind.

The Maverick doesn’t follow the trail. It makes its own.

Born to ride outside the lines.
colour: Weathered earthy khaki and muted brown undertones
hatband: Layered brown leather and braided cord band with turquoise and white beadwork, accented with feathers, brass-toned beads and a vintage bullet casing.
description: A weathered western hat with a sculpted crown, layered leather band, turquoise beadwork and bold feather accents.

name: Ghost Rider
tagline: Bold. Wild. One of a Kind.
subtitle: Handcrafted. Wild. Unmistakably Ghost Rider.
story:
Ghost Rider was made for the one who never follows the trail.

Deep black felt, weathered leather, turquoise beadwork, natural feathers and hand-tied details come together to give this hat its own wild spirit. Every piece was chosen and placed by hand, making Ghost Rider truly one of a kind.

Made to ride. Made to wander. Made to be remembered.
hatband: Handcrafted leather hatband with turquoise beadwork and rugged metal accents, giving Ghost Rider its distinctive western outlaw character.
description: A one-of-a-kind handcrafted western hat, finished with leather, turquoise, natural feathers and rugged outlaw details.

name: Rough Patch
tagline: Rough Patch — “Every scar tells a story. Every outlaw rides on.”
subtitle: Rough Patch — A hand-shaped black wool felt outlaw hat featuring layered bands, red accents, metal detailing, and feathers. Rugged, rebellious, and one of a kind. Built for those who've weathered a few storms.
story: Some things in life don’t come easy, and the best stories rarely come without a few scars. Rough Patch is a hand-shaped wool felt hat with weathered character, rich red detailing, layered textures, and a touch of wild spirit. Made from scratch for those who’ve been through a few things and come out with a little more grit.
material: Wool felt body, layered leather and fabric hatbands, metal accents, decorative feathers, and a hand-sewn interior sweatband.
colour: Distressed charcoal black with red accents, antique silver, and natural feather tones.
hatband: A rugged mix of layered leather and patterned red fabric, finished with antique metal accents and feathers.
description: A dark, weathered wool felt hat with a red edge and a little outlaw soul. Hand-shaped from scratch and finished with layered textures, metal accents, and feathers. Rough Patch has a story to tell — and it hasn’t all been pretty.
details: Hand-shaped and blocked wool felt body

name: Dark Horse
tagline: The Dark Horse — “Never underestimate the one you didn’t see coming.”
subtitle: A deep teal wool felt hat with dark detailing and a touch of outlaw attitude. Made for the wild cards who were never meant to follow the crowd.
story:
The Dark Horse

For the outsiders, the wild cards, and the ones who never fit the mould. The Dark Horse carries a little mystery, a little mischief, and a whole lot of attitude. Never the expected choice, always the one remembered.
material: Wool felt, leather, metal accents, feather.
colour: Deep teal green, brown, and antique silver.
hatband: Brown leather hatband with metal skull details, studs, and eyelets for a dark outlaw finish.
description: A deep teal wool felt hat with dark leather, skull accents, and a rebellious edge. For the wild cards who were never meant to follow the crowd.
